items.question: Which research approaches (for example observational or experimental) do ecology and evolution studies use?
systemQueries:
# id: research_approaches # Select paper, its title and the label of each research approach used (no LIMIT so every paper-approach pair is returned for counting) SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?approach ?approachLabel WHERE {
  # Link the paper to its contribution ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to contributions of the Study in Ecology & Evolution template ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  # Get the paper title ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Get the research approach resource of the contribution ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  # Get the human-readable label of the approach ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
} # Order by paper so the processing function can count papers per approach ORDER BY ?paperLabel

SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperTitle ?biomarkerProperty ?biomarker WHERE {
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperTitle ; orkgp:P31 ?contribution .

  ?biomarkerProperty rdfs:label ?propLabel .
